programme.title: Why Ships Sink: The Zeebrugge Disaster
programme.desc: On the 6 March 1987, the Herald of Free Enterprise ferry set sail from the Belgian port of Zeebrugge with 539 passengers and crew on board. Twenty minutes into her journey, she started to list uncontrollably - and 90 seconds later, she had capsized. The coastguard and local ships mounted a desperate rescue mission, but despite their efforts, 193 people lost their lives. It was the worst peacetime shipping disaster since the Titanic. This programme reveals the series of catastrophic errors that led to the disaster. Crew and passengers tell the story of what it was like onboard in gripping detail. And the coroner who investigated the tragedy speaks publicly for the first time since the accident. The crew made mistakes, but what emerges is a picture of an organisation whose commercial pressures to get as many people on board as possible and to leave port as soon as possible, contributed to serious safety failings. A lesson as important now as in 1987.

programme.title: Why Ships Sink: The Zeebrugge Disaster
programme.desc: On the 6 March 1987, the Herald of Free Enterprise ferry set sail from the Belgian port of Zeebrugge with 539 passengers and crew on board. Twenty minutes into her journey, she started to list uncontrollably - and 90 seconds later, she had capsized. The coastguard and local ships mounted a desperate rescue mission, but despite their efforts, 193 people lost their lives. It was the worst peacetime shipping disaster since the Titanic. This programme reveals the series of catastrophic errors that led to the disaster. Crew and passengers tell the story of what it was like onboard in gripping detail. And the coroner who investigated the tragedy speaks publicly for the first time since the accident. The crew made mistakes, but what emerges is a picture of an organisation whose commercial pressures to get as many people on board as possible and to leave port as soon as possible, contributed to serious safety failings. A lesson as important now as in 1987.

However, when an expert claims that the attacks are the work of a giant great white shark, there is only one solution - to kill the monster fish before it can feed again.

Having recovered from the grisly events of four years ago, the island is once again packed with tourists. Families are sailing in the bay and swimming off the beach, but when two divers and a water-skier go missing, the local police chief fears that he is about to relive his greatest nightmare.

programme.desc: Second sequel to Steven Spielberg's 1970s blockbuster transports the action from Amity Island to a new undersea kingdom attraction in a Florida theme park. The capture of a baby great white shark is big news and brings crowds to the park - until its mother arrives on the scene.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: Detective Nick Curran is charged with finding out the truth after Catherine Tramell, a sensual bisexual writer, is suspected of murdering her lover with an ice pick, exactly the method used in one of her books. Unfortunately, he becomes too closely involved.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: A CIA agent comes up against a duplicitous American government during his quest to nab a Colombian drug lord.

Betrayed by the other members of his gang, he is arrested and offered an experimental treatment in order to shorten his sentence.

programme.title: Scarface
programme.desc: After getting a green card in exchange for assassinating a Cuban government official, Tony Montana stakes a claim on the drug trade in Miami. Viciously murdering anyone who stands in his way, Tony eventually becomes the biggest drug lord in the state, controlling nearly all the cocaine that comes through Miami. But increased pressure from the police, wars with Colombian drug cartels and his own drug-fuelled paranoia serve to fuel the flames of his eventual downfall.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Musician Actors
programme.desc: From chart-topping singers to scene-stealing screen stars, this week's edition of The Cinema List celebrates musicians turned actors, featuring Dreamgirls and Wicked: For Good.

programme.title: See No Evil, Hear No Evil
programme.desc: Lighthearted adventures of a pair of news vendors in New York - one deaf, one blind - who go on the run when they are blamed for the murder of a customer. Each has seen - or heard - just a whiff of a clue, and a frantic chase ensues as the duo struggle to clear their names.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking
programme.desc: A pregnant woman was deserted by her partner. When she goes into labour, a friendly taxi driver rushes her to hospital and the pair become firm friends. He slowly falls in love with her and her baby, but she's still looking for the perfect partner, not realising he's right under her nose. However, we can hear the baby's thoughts, and he wants the guy as his dad.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking Too
programme.desc: A wisecracking toddler deals with toilet training, bickering parents and a baby sister in this sequel to the 1989 hit.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking Now
programme.desc: In the third of the 'Look Who's Talking' comedies, two dogs enter the Umbriacco household - and take an immediate dislike to each other. When Molly loses her job, husband James is forced to take on a demanding role as private airline pilot. The children miss him, so he buys a dog to cheer them up. However, when James's glamorous boss asks his family to look after her poodle, sparks fly between the dogs.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: An alcoholic millionaire is threatened with losing his inheritance if he does not marry the girl of his parents' choosing. Despite his dislike for his prospective bride, he bows to the inevitable only to meet a light-fingered waitress who steals his heart. John Gielgud won an Oscar for his role as Arthur's loyal but outspoken valet.

programme.title: The Man With Two Brains
programme.desc: Zany horror spoof about a brilliant brain surgeon who falls in love with a female brain stored in a jar. The brain is part of an impressive collection held by a colleague in Austria and, upon learning of his wife's infidelity, the surgeon allows himself to be charmed. Communicating telepathically with one of the specimens in the laboratory, he falls in love - but needs a body to put it in.

programme.title: Cloudy With a Chance of Meatballs
programme.desc: Inventor Flint Lockwood dreams of discovering an idea that will change people's lives forever, and after several misguided attempts he may just have done it. Flint has invented a machine that can turn water into delicious food, and, when his first demonstration accidentally sends the machine shooting into the clouds, cheeseburgers begin raining down from the sky.

programme.desc: Discovering that his most famous machine is now creating animal/vegetable hybrids, inventor Flint Lockwood and his friends venture forth to save the world from tacodiles, shrimpanzees and other creatures.

programme.desc: Award-winning DreamWorks animation from the Aardman team, telling the story of a band of chickens doomed to a life of egg-laying on a Yorkshire chicken farm. When a flamboyant American rooster arrives on the scene, the hens hope he can teach them to fly to freedom. However, when a chicken-pie making machine is installed, their need becomes urgent, and they must devise other means of escape.

programme.title: GOAT
programme.desc: A small goat named Will gets a once-in-a-lifetime shot to join the pros and play roarball -- a high-intensity, full-contact sport that's dominated by the fastest, fiercest animals in the world.

Training under Master Shifu, Po embarks on an epic high-kicking adventure as he sets out to thwart Tai Lung's evil plans. A DreamWorks animation.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda 2
programme.desc: A panda must unlock the secrets of his past in order to defeat a formidable villain who plans to wipe out kung fu and conquer China.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda 3
programme.desc: After reuniting with his long-lost father, Po must train a village of clumsy pandas to help him defeat a supernatural warrior who becomes stronger with each battle.

programme.title: Kong: Skull Island

Cut off from everything they know, they venture into the domain of the mighty Kong, igniting the ultimate battle between man and nature. As their mission of discovery soon becomes one of survival, they must fight to escape from a primal world where humanity does not belong.

The catch is that Bean is no art expert and his trip was a ploy by his British employers to get rid of him. Unfortunately, no one has warned the Americans about Mr Bean.

However, his trip doesn't go as smoothly as he expected when he has to face a series of misunderstandings and totally unfortunate coincidences. Eventually, Mr Bean will end up spoiling the last film of the snobbish director Carson Clay and appearing by accident at the Cannes Film Festival.

programme.desc: CNN's chief Washington correspondent, Jake Tapper, hosts this hour-long weekday afternoon program, which covers all the day's top stories from around the country and the world, headlines that span politics, money, sports and popular culture. `The Lead' works to ensure that viewers are caught up on the stories that matter, often highlighting news that may have been overlooked. Prior to joining CNN, Tapper served as senior White House correspondent at ABC News.

programme.title: Erin Burnett OutFront
programme.desc: It's Erin Burnett's turn to step out front and try to maintain a viable viewer presence for CNN in the weekday news arena. But the former CNBC anchor won't worry about ratings for her hourlong general news program, comparing that burden to "death." Instead, she'll concern herself with translating world events into relevant information for viewers, paying close attention to such topics as the Middle East and women's issues. "I want people to say that our show is smart. I want our show to be authentic", Burnett says in a promo. "I want our show to have courage". Left unsaid, of course, is that she wants her show to have a big audience, too.

programme.title: Smerconish
programme.desc: After serving as an MSNBC contributor and guest-host on the network for four years, TV and radio personality Michael Smerconish believed he was ready to head a show of his own. CNN agreed, and thus was born `Smerconish', an hourlong Saturday morning program that takes after its host's independent views. Using a topical, conversational format, he aims for the TV show to be an extension of his weekday radio broadcast, with free-flowing topics and the ability to discuss issues that strike a chord with the audience. Along the same lines, he thinks it's important to present the content in an engaging manner, free of my-way-or-the-highway ideology. Smerconish, who has a law degree from the University of Pennsylvania, is also a New York Times' best-selling author.

Using a topical, conversational format, he aims for the TV show to be an extension of his weekday radio broadcast, with free-flowing topics and the ability to discuss issues that strike a chord with the audience. Along the same lines, he thinks it's important to present the content in an engaging manner, free of my-way-or-the-highway ideology. Smerconish, who has a law degree from the University of Pennsylvania, is also a New York Times' best-selling author.

programme.title: Newsround
programme.desc: News magazine keeping young viewers up to date with the latest stories and events happening at home and abroad.

programme.title: Blue Peter
programme.desc: The cast of the new UK tour of High School Musical perform a show-stopping song.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: In a special programme exploring the enduring value of allotment life, Frances Tophill heads to Exmouth in Devon, where thriving plots and passionate growers are at the heart of a vibrant community.

programme.title: Beechgrove Garden
programme.desc: Brian Cunningham looks at which trees can be planted that will cope with wet conditions, and Carole Baxter is back with another one of her visits to a great Scottish garden.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It's the final, and the finalists tackle a cummerbund and bow tie, make beach outfits from tableware and create outfits on the theme of metamorphosis.

programme.title: Race Against the Tide
programme.desc: The tide is rising, and the pressure's mounting. Four teams face their tallest sand challenge yet. Who will soar and who will sink in the semi-final?

programme.title: Live: WSL
programme.desc: London City Lionesses meet local rivals Charlton Athletic in the Women's Super League.

programme.title: West Side Story
programme.desc: Against a backdrop of vicious gang warfare between the New Yorker Jets and the Puerto Rican Sharks, a romance develops across rival lines. 1960s update of 'Romeo and Juliet', with amazing song and dance sequences.

programme.title: Live: Super League Rugby
programme.desc: Action from the elimination play-offs as the race to the Super League grand final begins.

programme.title: BMW PGA Championship, DP World Tour Golf
programme.desc: Action from day 3 at Wentworth as a world-class field contests the flagship event on the DP World Tour. Two-time winner Alex Noren starts as defending champion following a dramatic play-off victory in the 2025 event. Other previous winners include Rory McIlroy, Luke Donald, Seve Ballesteros and Nick Faldo.

programme.title: Natural World
programme.desc: Following the adventures of first-time stoat mum Bandita as she raises her kits in a unique weasel wonderland, with over 50 hidden cameras. Cameras capture a tiny half-ounce orphaned least weasel called Twiz embark on her journey back to the wild.

programme.title: Glastonbury
programme.desc: The complete set by the undisputed Queen of Country from the Pyramid Stage in the now-traditional legends spot on Sunday afternoon. Dolly performs a rousing set including self-penned classics such as: 'Jolene' and 'I Will Always Love You'.

programme.title: Sisters in Country: Dolly, Linda and Emmylou
programme.desc: An exploration of how Dolly Parton, Linda Ronstadt and Emmylou Harris's careers took off in the 1970s. Each had a very distinct take on country, but they ended up uniting as close harmony singers and eventually collaborated on 1987's four-million-selling debut album, 'Trio'.

programme.title: Dolly Parton at the BBC
programme.desc: A look back at some of Dolly Parton's finest performances at the BBC, incorporating her greatest moments and hits such as 'Jolene', '9 to 5', 'Islands in the Stream' and 'Here You Come Again'.

programme.title: Green Man Festival Highlights 2026
programme.desc: Aleighcia Scott and Katie Owen present highlights from Green Man 2026, featuring Wolf Alice, The Beta Band, The Tubs, Panic Shack, Mwsog and Pigeon, all filmed in the magical Welsh mountain festival.

programme.title: International T20 Cricket
programme.desc: Action and highlights from an international Twenty20 cricket match.

programme.title: Kidnapped
programme.desc: After being secretly baptized in 1858, young Jewish boy Edgardo Mortara is taken from his family to be raised as a Christian in Bologna after he is abducted by the Papal Police.

programme.title: This Is BBC TWO
programme.desc: A preview of upcoming programmes from BBC Two.

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Joe Crowley, Datshiane Navanayagam and Adam Henson head to Westacre Estate in Norfolk to discover how a historic rural estate is adapting to survive in the modern world.

programme.title: Breakfast
programme.desc: The BBC's Breakfast programme features the latest news, sport, business, weather and other items on a daily basis.

programme.title: Weatherman Walking
programme.desc: Derek explores what lies beneath his feet when he revisits The Great Orme, the Offa's Dyke Path and the last surviving cast iron footbridge in Merthyr Tydfil.

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: The Landward team return for the autumn. Dougie is in the Cairngorms finding out how wildlife and precious habitats have been impacted by the summer's devastating wildfire. Anne reports from the ongoing scene of the fire to see the collective effort to put it out. Shahbaz is in Tayside meeting the scientists using technology to select the crops of the future. And Cammy learns the ropes as he takes part in a clifftop rescue with the coastguard.

programme.title: Saturday Kitchen Best Bites
programme.desc: Matt Tebbutt delivers a tasting menu from favourite Saturday Kitchen chefs. Shivi Ramoutar prepares her green seasoning chicken with coconut rice, peas and a splash of hot pepper sauce. Yotam Ottolenghi dishes up fillets of halibut in a spicy tomato sauce with a tahini dressing and a side of mint and feta-baked rice. Philip Khoury whips up his two-ingredient chocolate mousse served with an abundance of toppings, including chocolate curls, candied pistachios and pistachio praline.

programme.title: Lorraine Pascale: How to Be a Better Cook
programme.desc: Neil Forster is an impatient cook who reaches for the takeaway menu rather than making food from scratch. Lorraine shows him recipes including asparagus and cream cheese puff pastry tarts, a quick way to do roast chicken and an irresistible summer fruit pudding with a neat shortcut.

programme.title: Nigel and Adam's Farm Kitchen
programme.desc: Nigel cooks up our favourite ready meal, lasagne and tries to match the price of the off-the-shelf version of this popular dish. Adam meanwhile, sets his own challenge to grow durum wheat, used to make pasta, on the Cotswolds farm.

programme.title: Natural World
programme.desc: Real-life drama about a family chimps, who are trapped in the lost world of the Kyambura. This deep and ancient forested gorge runs through the African savannah and for years, it has been cut off from the rest of the jungle, leaving the chimps imprisoned. Here, they face a daily life-or-death dilemma; whether to leave the safety of the gorge and venture into the predator-ridden savannah to find food, or face hunger.

programme.title: The Big Deal
programme.desc: It's the grand final for the last three aspiring art dealer pairs. Competing at Frieze Week, only one can win the top prize of £50,000 worth of brilliant British art.

programme.title: Live: UCI Road World Championships
programme.desc: Jill Douglas presents live coverage of the UCI Road World Championships women's time trial - being held for the second time in Montreal, Canada.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin and the team are in the picturesque village of Saltaire, West Yorkshire. David Barby finds six tasty sandwich makers and Michael Baggott digs out a 400-year-old Laurel gold coin circa 1603-1625. Presenter Paul also visits Temple Newsam, a 17th century house being restored to its former glory by a dedicated and skilled restoration team.
